name: Chevening Scholarship
field_of_study: Any field; leadership, public policy, development, business, engineering, sciences
value: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel, arrival/departure allowance
eligibility: Citizen of a Chevening-eligible country including The Gambia; 2+ years work experience; return home for 2 years after study; meet UK university entry and English requirements
language_req: IELTS / English proficiency required by host university
description: The UK government's flagship global scholarship for future leaders to pursue a one-year master's at any UK university. Strongly values leadership, networking and a clear post-study plan to contribute back home.

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarship
field_of_study: Development-related fields; science, technology, health, education, governance
min_gpa: Upper second-class (2:1) honours or a lower second with a relevant master's
value: Tuition, airfare, living stipend, thesis and study grants
eligibility: Citizen of an eligible low/middle-income Commonwealth country including The Gambia; unable to afford UK study without support; willing to apply knowledge to home-country development
language_req: English proficiency as required by host university
description: Funded by the UK FCDO for students from developing Commonwealth countries to study a master's in the UK, with a strong development focus and an emphasis on impact back home.

name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarship
field_of_study: Selected taught master's programmes at partner UK universities
eligibility: Citizen of an eligible developing Commonwealth country including The Gambia; would not otherwise be able to study in the UK; applying to a participating programme
language_req: English proficiency as required by host university
description: Jointly funded by the CSC and UK universities for students who could not otherwise afford a UK master's, offered only on a fixed list of partner programmes each year.

name: GREAT Scholarships
field_of_study: Varies by participating university; many subjects offered
min_gpa: Meets entry requirements of the host university
value: GBP 10,000 toward tuition for a one-year postgraduate course
deadline: Varies by university (often spring) — verify current cycle
eligibility: Citizen of an eligible country; holds an offer or applies to a participating UK university; meets the course entry requirements
language_req: English proficiency as required by host university
description: A tuition grant scheme run by the British Council with UK universities, giving GBP 10,000 toward a postgraduate year. Good fit for students who can cover living costs but need help with fees.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
field_of_study: Any subject available at the University of Cambridge
value: Full cost of study, maintenance allowance, airfare, additional discretionary funding
eligibility: Any non-UK citizen including Gambian students; outstanding academic merit; clear reasons to study at Cambridge and commitment to improving others' lives
language_req: English proficiency as required by Cambridge
description: A highly competitive, fully funded scholarship to study any subject at Cambridge, selecting on intellectual ability, leadership and a commitment to improving the lives of others.

name: Türkiye Burslari (Türkiye Scholarships)
field_of_study: All fields, including medicine, engineering, social sciences, Islamic studies
min_gpa: 70% for undergraduate, 75% for postgraduate, 90% for medical sciences
value: Tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, airfare, one year of Turkish language course
eligibility: International student (non-Turkish citizen) including Gambian applicants; within the age limit for the level; meets the academic grade threshold
language_req: Turkish or English depending on programme; one year of Turkish provided
description: The Turkish government's comprehensive scholarship covering an entire degree at any level, including a preparatory year of Turkish, accommodation and a stipend. A single application can be considered for several universities.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
field_of_study: Engineering, science, medicine, economics, Chinese language, business and more
min_gpa: Good academic standing; varies by host university and programme
value: Tuition, accommodation or housing allowance, monthly stipend, comprehensive medical insurance
deadline: Varies by university, roughly December to April — verify current cycle
eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen including Gambian applicants in good health; meets the age and academic requirements for the chosen level
language_req: Chinese (HSK) or English-taught programme depending on course
description: China's flagship government scholarship, usually applied for through a chosen Chinese university or via an embassy nomination, covering tuition, accommodation and a stipend across all degree levels.

name: Confucius Institute Scholarship (International Chinese Language Teachers)
provider: Center for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC)
field_of_study: Teaching Chinese to speakers of other languages, Chinese language and literature
min_gpa: Good academic standing; HSK results weighed heavily
value: Tuition, accommodation, living stipend, comprehensive medical insurance
deadline: Varies, often spring (May) — verify current cycle
eligibility: Non-Chinese citizen including Gambian applicants; interested in Chinese language and culture; meets HSK score requirements
description: Aimed at students who want to study the Chinese language or train as Chinese-language teachers, with funding tied to HSK proficiency results. A strong route for language-focused applicants.

name: AMCI Moroccan Government Scholarship
field_of_study: Medicine, engineering, sciences, law, economics, Islamic studies and more
min_gpa: Strong secondary or undergraduate results; varies by programme
value: Monthly stipend and tuition placement; travel and living costs generally not covered
deadline: Spring (applications routed through the Moroccan embassy) — verify current cycle
eligibility: African and other partner-country students including Gambians; applications submitted via the Moroccan diplomatic mission, not an online portal
language_req: French (and Arabic for some programmes); language preparation may be provided
description: A government scholarship for African students offering a stipend and a university place in Morocco. Applications go through the Moroccan embassy rather than a website, so plan extra time for paperwork.

name: Al Akhawayn University Merit Scholarship
field_of_study: Business, engineering, computer science, social sciences, humanities
min_gpa: Strong academic record; merit assessed on prior results
value: Partial tuition reduction based on merit and need
deadline: Rolling by admission term — verify current cycle
eligibility: Admitted students including international applicants; awarded on academic merit and demonstrated financial need
description: An English-taught, American-style university in Morocco offering merit-based tuition reductions. A good option for students who want a North African base with an English curriculum.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
provider: U.S. Department of State (Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs)
field_of_study: Most fields; some restrictions on clinical medicine
min_gpa: Strong academic record; competitive at graduate level
value: Tuition, living stipend, airfare, health benefits
deadline: Set by the in-country U.S. Embassy / commission — verify current cycle
eligibility: Non-U.S. citizen including Gambian applicants; applies through the U.S. Embassy in The Gambia; intends to return home after the grant
description: The flagship U.S. government exchange scholarship for graduate study, applied for through the U.S. Embassy. Selection weighs academic merit, leadership and a plan to contribute at home.

name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
field_of_study: All fields, with an emphasis on leadership and giving back to Africa
min_gpa: Strong academic record alongside demonstrated leadership and financial need
value: Tuition, accommodation, books, stipend, travel and mentoring support
deadline: Varies by partner university — verify current cycle
eligibility: African students including Gambians with academic talent but limited means; commitment to leadership and giving back to the continent
language_req: English proficiency as required by host university
description: A comprehensive scholarship for academically talented African students facing financial barriers, covering the full cost of study plus mentoring, applied for through specific partner universities.

name: AAUW International Fellowships
value: Fellowship stipend (master's, doctoral and postdoctoral tiers)
eligibility: Women who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents, including Gambian women; intend to return to their home country to pursue a professional career
description: Fellowships for women from outside the U.S. pursuing graduate or postdoctoral study, with the expectation of returning home to advance women and girls. Open to all fields.

name: Ibn Khaldun Scholarship (Türkiye)
field_of_study: Social sciences, humanities, Islamic studies, African studies
value: Tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, airfare, Turkish language course
deadline: Aligned with the Türkiye Burslari cycle (around February) — verify current cycle
eligibility: Students from African countries including The Gambia; pursuing graduate study in the social sciences and humanities
language_req: Turkish or English depending on programme; Turkish course provided
description: A Türkiye Burslari track aimed specifically at African graduate students in the social sciences and humanities, with the same full funding package as the main programme.
